title: Analista de Salesforce Pleno (Noturno)
description:
Você na Deloitte!

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Buscamos um profissional Analista de Salesforce Pleno que irá atuar com:

  • Desenvolvimento low-code ou APEX e LWC;
  • Desenvolvimento ou desenho de APIs;
  • Escrever documentações técnicas e/ou funcionais;
  • Explorar ferramentas de GenAI para acelerar processo de desenvolvimento de software e escrita de documentações;
  • Versionamento e deploy de código.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ter experiência com desenvolvimento de código ou atuação funcional em Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento de Deploy via Metadata API;
  • Graduação Completa;
  • Certificações App Builder e Admin.

title: Analytics Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores. 28 anos de história e 15x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW). Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um Analytics Engineer (Pleno), confira as informações da vaga:


Descrição da Vaga

Atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de pipelines de dados e soluções analíticas escaláveis , transformando dados brutos em insights estratégicos para o negócio . Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais para garantir qualidade, acessibilidade e usabilidade dos dados , promovendo uma cultura data-driven na organização.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar modelagem de dados para atender às necessidades específicas dos times de negócio.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders para compreender demandas e desenvolver produtos de dados (pipelines, indicadores e dashboards) com foco no usuário final.
  • Desenvolver datasets que servirão como fonte única da verdade da empresa , seguindo a arquitetura Medallion (Gold/Diamond) .
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas fontes e plataformas, propondo e implementando soluções automatizadas.
  • Implementar melhorias em processos internos por meio da disponibilização de dados e datasets escaláveis .
  • Atuar como defensor do valor de negócio dos dados , oferecendo orientação técnica e soluções para desafios estratégicos.
  • Construir, manter e evoluir pipelines analíticos com a abordagem de dados como produto , desde o dado bruto até o dado ouro, pronto para consumo por algoritmos e réguas de comunicação.
  • Monitorar a saúde, qualidade e performance da infraestrutura analítica , realizando otimizações contínuas.
  • Desenvolver análises, visualizações, gráficos e dashboards a partir da infraestrutura de dados implementada.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e de infraestrutura em projetos técnicos e evolutivos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência na escrita de queries em SQL, Python e/ou R , com foco em performance e escalabilidade .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados , como Looker, Power BI ou similares.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e analíticos , como BigQuery e Redshift .


Interessou?

Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte de um time que valoriza técnica, protagonismo e impacto real nas soluções!

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Stripe & Fintech Specialist)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Stripe Connect to lead the evolution of a critical payment infrastructure.

This role will be responsible for architecting and implementing a robust Stripe Connect integration within a core Django API, supporting the migration from a legacy Ruby on Rails payment portal.

You will lead the end-to-end payment lifecycle - from onboarding and funds flow to webhook orchestration and complex business logic - ensuring scalability, security, and reliability across payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement Stripe Connect integrations (Standard, Express, or Custom) within a Django/Python environment
  • Design and build complex payment flows (split payments, payouts, fee collection)
  • Develop resilient, idempotent webhook processing systems for real-time Stripe events
  • Lead migration of payment logic and data from a legacy Ruby on Rails application into a Django-based architecture
  • Integrate Stripe events with core backend workflows and business processes
  • Implement asynchronous processing using Celery and Redis for high-volume payment tasks
  • Ensure adherence to PCI-DSS standards and best practices for financial data security
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and logging for payment flows (Datadog, Sentry, or similar tools)
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, maintaining high test coverage


Technical Stack

Backend: Python 3.11+, Django 4.x, Django REST Framework (DRF)

Payments: Stripe (Connect, Billing, Webhooks)

Task Queue: Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ)

Database: PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless v2)

Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, ElastiCache)


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building production-grade payment systems
  • Deep understanding of Stripe Connect and marketplace payment architectures
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to modern backend frameworks
  • Solid knowledge of asynchronous architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex backend initiatives

title: Arquiteto .Net
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de microsserviços robustas, escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Aplicar os princípios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) para modelar sistemas complexos.
  • Definir a estratégia de containerização e orquestração de serviços, garantindo a portabilidade e a alta disponibilidade.
  • Garantir a observabilidade das soluções, implementando ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento, tracing e logging.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções com foco em Clean Architecture e na cultura de testes de software para assegurar a qualidade e a confiabilidade do código.
  • Explorar e propor novas tecnologias e abordagens para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Software ou em papéis semelhantes, com forte background em tecnologias Microsoft (.NET Core).
  • Conhecimento em: containerização e orquestração de contêineres (Docker, OpenShift e etc.)
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Event-Driven Architecture (EDA).
  • Clean Architecture.
  • Microservices.
  • Testes de software (TDD, BDD, etc.).
  • Observabilidade (ex.: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência em ambientes de inovação, como prototipagem rápida, experimentação com novas ferramentas e integração de IA/ML é um diferencial.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidades de comunicação excelentes, com capacidade de mentorar equipes e apresentar soluções técnicas.

  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de microsserviços robustas, escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Aplicar os princípios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) para modelar sistemas complexos.
  • Definir a estratégia de containerização e orquestração de serviços, garantindo a portabilidade e a alta disponibilidade.
  • Garantir a observabilidade das soluções, implementando ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento, tracing e logging.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções com foco em Clean Architecture e na cultura de testes de software para assegurar a qualidade e a confiabilidade do código.
  • Explorar e propor novas tecnologias e abordagens para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Software ou em papéis semelhantes, com forte background em tecnologias Microsoft (.NET Core).
  • Conhecimento em: containerização e orquestração de contêineres (Docker, OpenShift e etc.)
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Event-Driven Architecture (EDA).
  • Clean Architecture.
  • Microservices.
  • Testes de software (TDD, BDD, etc.).
  • Observabilidade (ex.: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência em ambientes de inovação, como prototipagem rápida, experimentação com novas ferramentas e integração de IA/ML é um diferencial.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidades de comunicação excelentes, com capacidade de mentorar equipes e apresentar soluções técnicas.

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;
  • Homologar processos dos sistemas junto aos usuários, prestando apoio técnico, orientando-os na sua operacionalização e validação;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.

Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.

The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.

  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.

title: Técnico Químico / Colorista
description:
Sobre a Empresa



A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional líder no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países e 80 anos de história no Brasil, nosso compromisso é oferecer as melhores soluções em tintas para as mais diversas finalidades, atendendo às necessidades de nossos clientes com qualidade e inovação.



Sobre o Papel



Estamos em busca de um Técnico Químico I cujas principais serão responsável por realizar o desenvolvimento, ajuste e controle de cores em tintas automotivas e industriais, com ênfase em sólidas (monocromáticas), perolizadas e metálicas. Atuará diretamente no laboratório de desenvolvimento, criando formulações, garantindo reprodutibilidade e suportando áreas como P&D, Qualidade e Produção. Local de atuação: Sumaré / São Paulo.



Responsabilidades



  • Desenvolver novas cores sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas conforme demandas de clientes, tendências de mercado ou projetos internos.
  • Ajustar tonalidade, flop, brilho e efeitos especiais utilizando pigmentos metálicos e perolizados.
  • Realizar correções de cor utilizando espectrofotômetro, software colorimétrico e cabine de luz.
  • Executar testes físico-químicos: viscosidade, brilho, aderência, resistência, densidade, entre outros.
  • Avaliar curvas de cor, diferença ΔE, metálicos e flop no espectrofotômetro.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e fichas de formulação.
  • Registrar ajustes, histórico de lotes e parâmetros críticos do processo.
  • Suportar o time de produção em ajustes de tonalidade em escala industrial.
  • Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Vendas em projetos especiais e atendimento ao cliente.



Qualificações


  • Conhecimentos Essenciais
  • Experiência comprovada em tintas sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas (automotivas, industriais ou repintura).
  • Domínio de espectrofotômetro e softwares colorimétricos (ex.: Datacolor, X-Rite).
  • Conhecimento em pigmentação, dispersão e comportamento de flake metálico e mica perolizada.
  • Leitura e interpretação de curvas de cor e parâmetros Lab*.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em laboratório de P&D.
  • Conhecimento em colorimetria avançada e ajustes complexos (high flop, alto brilho, efeitos especiais).


Formação Acadêmica


  • Técnico em Química (obrigatório).
  • Superior em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • CRQ ativo.



Experiência Mínima


2 a 5 anos em laboratório de tintas, preferencialmente com foco em cores especiais (metálicas e perolizadas).

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass

title: Java Kafka Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and streambased processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle highthroughput workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support businesscritical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP

Responsibilities Include

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including

Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs

Build and optimize messagedriven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka

Develop scalable resilient APIs and backend services

Write clean maintainable and welltested code following industry best practices

Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments

Work closely with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations

Participate in code reviews system design discussions and operational readiness efforts

Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure

Prototyping of new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineering velocity

Qualities Experience Were Seeking

We believe the right individual will have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role

A BS degree or higher in Engineering Computer Science or a related field is required

5 years of software engineering experience

Strong Java experience in backend or distributed systems environments

Handson experience with Kafka producers consumers partitions topics offsets stream processing etc

Proficiency in Nodejs for backend application development

Experience deploying and maintaining services running in Kubernetes

Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CICD

Handson experience with AWS andor GCP cloud platforms

Solid understanding of software design patterns system architecture and microservices principles

Experience working with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design performance considerations migrations

Strong debugging problemsolving and communication skills

Excellent problemsolving critical thinking and communication skills

Ability to work within a distributed team

Nice to have

VOD Streaming experience

Experience with React basic frontend integration work context management UI components

Exposure to infrastructureascode tools Terraform Helm etc

Monitoringobservability tools Datadog NewRelic

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer/Training Content Creator


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing SaaS organization within the healthcare sector, is seeking an experienced Instructional Designer / Content Training Creator to support product adoption and end-user engagement.

This individual will be responsible for developing high-quality training materials aligned to new feature releases and product enhancements. Content will include step-by-step documentation, video tutorials, and embedded in-app learning resources.

The ideal candidate is structured, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative — capable of working cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure training materials are accurate, timely, and aligned with customer needs.

This role directly supports customer adoption, user enablement, and long-term retention.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in instructional design, technical writing, or SaaS training content creation
  • Experience creating both written documentation and video tutorials
  • Strong ability to translate technical product features into user-friendly materials
  • Experience supporting SaaS product releases
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience
  • Familiarity with knowledge base or help desk platforms
  • Experience embedding or structuring in-app training resources preferred


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within healthcare or other regulated SaaS environments
  • Experience supporting product adoption initiatives
  • Familiarity with user enablement or digital adoption strategies
  • Experience working in fast-paced, release-driven environments


Key Responsibilities


Training Content Development

  • Develop clear, structured training materials for new feature releases and product updates
  • Create step-by-step documentation, user guides, and process walkthroughs
  • Produce video tutorials and screen-recorded demonstrations
  • Maintain consistent instructional design standards across all materials

Product Release Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and internal stakeholders during the feature release lifecycle
  • Translate technical functionality into user-friendly instructional content
  • Document workflows, use cases, and feature capabilities
  • Track release timelines to ensure training materials are delivered in sync with launch

Content Maintenance & Optimization

  • Audit and update existing training materials as product functionality evolves
  • Ensure documentation accuracy and consistency
  • Identify content gaps impacting user adoption
  • Improve clarity and accessibility of user-facing materials

Platform & Knowledge Base Integration

  • Prepare content for embedding within the application and support platform
  • Organize materials for easy user navigation and searchability
  • Support continuous improvement of knowledge base structure

Adoption & Enablement Support

  • Create content that drives end-user adoption of key modules and features
  • Develop materials aligned to different user personas
  • Monitor feedback from Customer Success and Support teams to refine training assets

Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), com foco em componentes escaláveis e integrações com plataformas digitais do Serasa;
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais e garantir aderência às boas práticas recomendadas pela Adobe;
  • Atuar próximo aos times de negócio e tecnologia, assegurando qualidade técnica, performance e estabilidade das entregas;
  • Desenvolver componentes, funcionalidades e integrações utilizando tecnologias relacionadas ao ecossistema AEM;

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Hands-on experience with WCS, TMS, and Parcel integrations (any).

• Experience developing/modifying interfaces, tracing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Knowledge of middleware integration methods (JDA Connect, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong positive attitude, ownership mindset, and focus on process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively participate in Solution Design workshops and lead end-to-end solution architecture discussions.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Lead Change Management activities for global or regional implementations.

• Contribute to the Global Technology Strategy and present technical assessments to governance boards for rapid decision-making.

• Prepare and deliver presentations to users, management, and executive-level audiences.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and functional designs.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

Required Qualifications

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Realizar a gestão de projetos analisando o contexto da empresa e do cliente e controlando os contratos, visando a sua execução e finalização, dentro dos prazos, escopo, custos, riscos e qualidade acordados entre empresa, cliente e fornecedor.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos em GIS e na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Metodologias Ágil em geral e/ou pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Projetos e/ou experiência comprovada em Gestão de Projetos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Conceito de metodologias de Gestão de Projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar Projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com uma carteira de aproximadamente 10 projetos simultâneos, sendo responsável, de forma integrada, pela comunicação, escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, profissionais, fornecedores, stakeholders, riscos, visando o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Responder pelo planejamento, estruturação e viabilização das condições para execução dos projetos, alinhado com os objetivos e diretrizes definidos pelo cliente e pela empresa, aplicando metodologia de gestão de projetos, ferramentas de metodologias ágeis, provendo e utilizando os processos, técnicas e artefatos (documentos) pré-definidos, buscando atender aos resultados de custo, qualidade, produtividade e margem esperados;
  • Realizar a coordenação matricial da equipe técnica alocada de forma adequada e coerente, analisando o contexto da empresa e do cliente e controlando os contratos.
  • Gerenciar contratos como preposto.
  • Responder pelo planejamento, estruturação e viabilização das condições para execução dos projetos, alinhando com os objetivos e diretrizes definidos pelo cliente e pela empresa, aplicando metodologia de gestão de projetos, provendo e utilizando os processos, técnicas e artefatos (documentos) pré-definidos, buscando atender aos resultados de custo, qualidade, produtividade e margem esperados;
  • Ter visão de negócio Imagem e Cliente propondo soluções/projetos;
  • Ter habilidade na condução de reuniões e atendimento a clientes.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.

We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.

UST is waiting for you!

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: English Teacher
description:
Vaga: Professora de Inglês – Turno Noite - 100% Remoto

A  Zibordi English , está ampliando o time de professoras.

Buscamos uma profissional com disponibilidade no período da manhã para integrar nossa equipe fixa e contribuir com o propósito de tornar o aprendizado do inglês uma experiência leve, eficiente e humanizada, por meio de uma metodologia própria, testada e aprovada por centenas de alunos ao redor do mundo.

Sobre o cargo

A professora será responsável por conduzir aulas online para alunos com diferentes objetivos, sempre com foco em comunicação real, segurança e evolução contínua.

Todo o suporte pedagógico, materiais e direcionamentos serão fornecidos pela escola.

Procuramos alguém pontual, comprometida, comunicativa e genuinamente interessada em acompanhar o progresso dos alunos.

Horário de trabalho

Segunda a sexta-feira

Das 18:00 às 21:00 (horário de Brasília)

Carga horária fixa: 3 horas por dia

Remuneração

R$ 1.200,00 mensais fixos , independentemente de cancelamentos ou ausência de alunos.

Havendo abertura de novos horários ou turmas extras, o pagamento será realizado à parte.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir aulas de inglês online de forma dinâmica, respeitosa e acolhedora
  • Manter o foco na conversação e na confiança do aluno
  • Direcionar dúvidas ou situações pedagógicas à coordenação
  • Participar de treinamentos e alinhamentos periódicos

Diferenciais da oportunidade

  • Salário fixo garantido
  • Trabalho remoto
  • Planejamento pedagógico estruturado
  • Treinamento completo na metodologia da escola
  • Possibilidade real de expansão de carga horária e crescimento interno

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: SQL Architect / Azure Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: SQL Architect / Azure Solution Architect

Experience: 15+ Years

Role: Solution / Technical Architect

Location: Remote

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced SQL Architect / Azure Solution Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure cloud solutions and large-scale migration projects. The candidate will be responsible for assessing existing infrastructure, designing Azure target architecture, and leading cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform AS-IS infrastructure and application assessments .
  • Design Azure target architecture , HLD & LLD diagrams.
  • Lead cloud migration activities using Azure Migrate.
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zone solutions .
  • Provide Azure solution design including SQL, Storage, IAM, and Key Vault .
  • Support infrastructure, performance, and troubleshooting activities in Azure and Windows environments.
  • Design data storage, DR, and business continuity solutions .
  • Work with stakeholders and project teams to deliver migration solutions.

Required Skills

  • Microsoft Azure Architecture
  • Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS)
  • Azure Migrate
  • Azure Storage & Key Vault
  • Azure Identity & Access Management
  • Cloud Migration & Infrastructure Design
  • SQL Architecture

The candidate will be responsible for assessing existing infrastructure, designing Azure target architecture, and leading cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform AS-IS infrastructure and application assessments .
  • Design Azure target architecture , HLD & LLD diagrams.
  • Lead cloud migration activities using Azure Migrate.
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zone solutions .
  • Provide Azure solution design including SQL, Storage, IAM, and Key Vault .
  • Support infrastructure, performance, and troubleshooting activities in Azure and Windows environments.
  • Design data storage, DR, and business continuity solutions .
  • Work with stakeholders and project teams to deliver migration solutions.

Required Skills

  • Microsoft Azure Architecture
  • Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS)
  • Azure Migrate
  • Azure Storage & Key Vault
  • Azure Identity & Access Management
  • Cloud Migration & Infrastructure Design
  • SQL Architecture

description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Advanced English
  • Design and architect the CRM solution to leverage the full capabilities of the Salesforce platform.
  • Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases; evaluate, recommend, and implement relevant new capabilities or optimizations.
  • Manage sandbox environments including refresh planning, data seeding, pre/post refresh steps and reconfigurations
  • Manage release and deployment activities following Salesforce DevOps best practices using Salesforce DX, and Git-based workflows
  • Manage operational aspects of Saleforce.com with a focus on system configuration and deployments, standardization, data integration, data quality, and technical issue resolution
  • Participate in formal governance and change/release management processes
  • Proficient on building and maintaining standard and ad hoc reports and dashboards
  • Ensure proper security models are in place and maintained for data access

PERSON:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • 5-7+ years of Salesforce.com Administration experience implementing/supporting Sales Cloud on Lightning for a base of at least 300 users
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator and Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
  • Certified Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant & Salesforce Agentforce Specialist highly preferred
  • Experience leveraging and configuring AppExchange products to develop CRM solutions
  • Experience with general salesforce setup and configuration such as flows, validation rules, triggers, field updates, page layouts, record types, formula fields, report types etc.
  • Experience in environment maintenance tasks such as managing admin access, managing sandboxes, handling confidential data, integration configurations
  • Knowledge of Data Cloud (Data 360) for unified customer data strategy. Hands-on with Einstein Analytics/CRM Analytics
  • Understanding of Agentforce 360 concepts and readiness for AI-enabled service and automation
  • Operational experience in non-Salesforce environments
  • Experience in JIRA and GitHub
  • Experience with Salesforce Backup & Restore, DocuSign CLM
  • Experience in DevOps & Data Tools: Salesforce DevOps, Salesforce Inspector, Data Loader, Dataloader io, Change Sets

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
AI Platform Engineer (LLM Systems and Retrieval)

Contract, Remote | Azure preferred

Company Description

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled SaaS and automation products that help teams move faster, operate leaner, and scale without adding headcount. We also create custom, bespoke SaaS solutions for businesses with specific pain points, turning messy data and manual operations into reliable software systems. We ship fast, iterate weekly, and operate with high ownership in a high-performing, execution-driven team.

Role Description

As our AI Platform Engineer, you will build and own the shared AI platform that powers every Alyra product and client deployment. You will design and ship the core services behind ingestion and indexing, retrieval with enforceable citations, evaluation, observability, multi-tenant security, and cost and latency controls. This is a production engineering role, not research or prompt-only. You will work day-to-day with our engineering team to turn real customer problems into reusable platform capabilities, define the platform APIs and reference implementations teams build on, and own production performance through monitoring, incident response, and continuous hardening.

Contract Details

  • Hours: 20 hours per week
  • Duration: Long-term partnership
  • Rate: Depending on skills and experience

Responsibilities

  • Build reusable platform services: ingestion workers, indexing service, retrieval API, evaluation service
  • Build and maintain .NET APIs and background workers (auth, queues, scheduled jobs) in Azure
  • Implement grounded answering with enforceable citations and traceability
  • Design structured outputs with schemas, validation, confidence scoring, and fallbacks
  • Implement hybrid retrieval, reranking, and document hierarchy modeling
  • Own reliability: idempotency, dedupe, retries, poison-queue handling, safe reprocessing, reindexing, and backfills
  • Implement RBAC and document-level authorization across API, retrieval, and storage
  • Maintain auditability: correlation IDs and logs linking input docs, chunks, prompts, model runs, citations, and outputs
  • Instrument observability across stages (ingest, extract, index, retrieve, generate) tied to quality, latency, and cost
  • Optimize cost and performance with batching, caching, model routing, and indexing strategy
  • Deliver enterprise engineering patterns: API versioning, feature flags, staged rollouts, load testing, runbooks, backups and DR thinking

Tech Stack

  • Azure: Blob Storage, Functions, Service Bus, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence
  • Services: C#/.NET and Python
  • Security and Ops: Azure Key Vault, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry, Terraform (preferred)
  • Docker, CI/CD
  • Postgres with pgvector, optional graph layer for document structure

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • 4+ years software, backend, or data engineering
  • 2+ years shipping production LLM or applied AI systems
  • Strong C#/.NET and Python, comfortable shipping services in both
  • Strong .NET backend experience shipping APIs and workers in production (ASP.NET Core, BackgroundService, async concurrency)
  • Deep experience with distributed systems patterns: queues, retries, idempotency, backpressure, rate limiting, timeouts, circuit breakers

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts

Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Scrum Master
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como Scrum Master , desempenhando papel fundamental na condução e evolução das práticas ágeis dentro da equipe. O(A) candidato(a) ideal deverá possuir habilidades sólidas de facilitação, comunicação e liderança servidora, contribuindo de forma estratégica para a melhoria contínua dos processos, para o alinhamento entre as áreas e para a entrega de valor ao negócio. Procuramos alguém comprometido(a) com a cultura ágil e com a criação de um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e orientado a resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias do framework Scrum, como Daily Scrum , Sprint Planning , Sprint Review e Sprint Retrospective;
  • Atuar na remoção de impedimentos que possam comprometer o desempenho do time;
  • Promover a adoção e a correta aplicação das metodologias ágeis, garantindo entendimento e comprometimento da equipe;
  • Fomentar a melhoria contínua, identificando oportunidades e propondo ajustes nos processos;
  • Assegurar comunicação efetiva entre equipe, Product Owner e demais stakeholders;
  • Proteger a equipe de interferências externas, assegurando foco nas prioridades da sprint;
  • Monitorar métricas ágeis e orientar o time quanto a sua interpretação e evolução;
  • Incentivar um ambiente colaborativo, motivado e orientado à entrega de valor.

Requisitos:

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em funções relacionadas a times ágeis;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Scrum, Kanban e princípios Lean;
  • Capacidade de facilitar reuniões e mediar conflitos;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Proatividade, organização e postura orientada a resultados.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificações como PSM I , CSM , SMAC ou equivalentes;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão ágil (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Trello);
  • Vivência com times de tecnologia ou ambientes de transformação digital;
  • Familiaridade com métricas ágeis e técnicas de estimativa.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.

We need tutors who can start immediately!

Characteristics

Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite

Requirements

  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

About LatinHire

Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

  • Auxílio na execução dos treinamentos. (PCI, Segurança da Informação, LGPD e outros);
  • Disseminação das políticas e procedimentos de segurança HST;
  • Execução de processo de gestão de vulnerabilidades com os demais círculos envolvidos, visando elevar a segurança em todos os serviços e produtos da HST;
  • Execução de simulações de resposta a incidentes e continuidade de negócios, visando manter a resiliência da empresa em situações adversas.

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em cursos relacionados à tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento básico em certificação PCI;
  • Conhecimento básico em normas de proteção de dados pessoais (LGPD);
