  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.

The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.

About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)

You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects

What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary

Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.

The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.

About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)

You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects

What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.

About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment

End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.

Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.

Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!

Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.

Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.
  • English speaking

Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.

Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: Remote Senior Java Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience:

- 5 to 10 years of experience as a backend engineer within a Java environment

- Java version 17 and above

- GCP experience (will consider Multi Cloud experience - AWS, Azure)

- Interest in working with modern tools & Technologies

- Open-source Java framework experience (Quarkus preferred but Spring is okay)

- Microservices experience

- Terraform experience

- Able to work in a very fast paced environment

- Experience and willingness to be testing your own code

Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

Golang

Job Description:

Our client is looking for Senior Back End Java Engineers to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and documenting the back-end services for their mobile app and website while coaching and mentoring junior resources and collaborating with other team members and stakeholders. You will also drive best practices, ensure the technical feasibility of integrations, and optimize the application for maximum speed, scalability, and reliability. You will investigate and utilize Google Cloud Platform services to continuously improve application architecture and implement microservices using Java and Quarkus framework. You will propose and enhance automation initiatives related to infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting and contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle. This is an established company and environment with a startup feel so you must be able work in a fast-paced environment and used to timelines that are in days instead of weeks. This role is fully remote and long term.

The salary for this position is between 274,517BRL - 329,421.45BRL.

Please apply if you are interested in learning more and we can set up a time to speak further!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.

Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns

What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer  

Are you a  visionary and highly creative Graphic Designer with a passion for crafting visually stunning, high-impact brand materials? We are excited to offer you a 100% remote opportunity to make a significant  visual identity impact with a fast-growing US-based data intelligence and marketing company. 

About us  

Meet Recruxo! We are passionate about connecting Latin America’s top-tier talent with US businesses. With nearly a decade of experience, we're committed to quality, service, and your success.

We offer access to 100% remote opportunities, competitive salaries, and dynamic US companies. 

About our client  

Company is a data-driven platform built for the parking, mobility, and real-estate industries. They help operators unify their systems, visualize performance, and engage customers through connected digital experiences. They offer a full-service creative and marketing service. 

They bring experience to life—combining brand strategy, creative execution, and behavior-based marketing to drive measurable growth across every asset. They work across branding, content, signage, campaigns, and digital experiences that connect real-world touchpoints to data and performance insights. 

What they offer:  

  • Competitive pay 
  • Schedule:  Central Standard Time   
  • Location: 100% remote from Latin America  
  • Great Benefits: 10 days PTO and  US Holidays  
  • Professional growth: Opportunities to learn and develop new skills 

Role Overview  

We are seeking a versatile, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to support the execution of high-quality design across the Company’s client portfolio. You’ll collaborate closely with the marketing, product, and client teams to translate business goals into compelling creative—from brand development and signage to campaign assets, digital layouts, pitch decks, and microsite content. 

This is an opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing creative team shaping the visual standard for some of the most innovative operators in parking, mobility, and urban environments. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Execute on-brand visual assets for marketing collatoral 
  • Create graphics for social content, email, SMS, paid media, and event activations 
  • Support production of pitch decks, reports, presentations, and sales collateral 
  • Translate creative briefs into original concepts that align with client brand identity and campaign objectives 
  • Produce signage and onsite print materials (posters, wayfinding, QR-led promotions, programs, etc.) 
  • Maintain and evolve visual identity across client and Company brand touchpoints 
  • Prepare and deliver production-ready files for print and web 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to ensure cohesive storytelling and brand alignment 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deliver consistently on deadline 
  • Develop and maintain reusable templates to streamline recurring designs 
  • Digest campaign performance and optimize creative based on data-driven insights 

Requirements  

  • 2–5 years of design experience (agency or creative studio preferred) 
  • Strong portfolio showing branding, campaign execution, and digital + print work 
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) 
  • Proficiency with Figma
  • Proficiency with Canva 
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy 
  • Ability to take direction, iterate, and refine work based on feedback 
  • Comfortable contributing to both rapid-turn production work and longer-term brand design 
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills 
  • Experience handling multiple client deliverables 

Nice-to-Have  

  • Illustration 
  • Motion graphics or animation 
  • Photography or video editing 
  • Experience in mobility, parking, or real-estate industries 
  • Experience designing for SaaS or platform-based products 

What Success Looks Like  

  • Produces thoughtful, on-brand creative that elevates client engagement 
  • Brings clarity, purpose, and consistency to visual communication 
  • Delivers high-quality work on deadline across multiple project streams 
  • Demonstrates curiosity and applies learning to future creative iterations 
  • Helps expand and maintain a scalable creative system for clients and Company 

Who You Are  

  • A creative thinker with strong attention to detail 
  • Passionate about bringing ideas to life visually 
  • Collaborative, communicative, and energized by creative problem-solving 
  • Able to balance quick-turn production work with high-concept projects 
  • Excited to help shape the brand expression of new experiences, products, and spaces 

Ready to dive into a challenging and rewarding role?   

We can't wait to hear from you – apply through the link at the top of the page! 

NOTES:   

Only resumes written in English will be considered

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Brand Manager / Brand Development Leader - LATAM market
description:
Note: Please send your CV in English

Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.

Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).
  • B2C marketing and virality: Identifying and executing bold and unconventional promotional ideas with viral potential. Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.
  • Creative leadership: Providing deep context, strong hooks, and detailed briefs for the design and animation teams.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.

title: UI/UX Designer (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote UI/UX Designer with 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design to to partner closely with the Product and Engineering teams to elevate usability, visual consistency, and user experience across the platforms of our U.S. client. You will work 10 hours per week in a hands-on role supporting new feature design, workflow improvements, and visual system enhancements across the SaaS products. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in B2B software environments, translating product requirements into thoughtful user experiences, and collaborating with crossfunctional teams.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive user experiences for complex SaaS workflows and data-heavy applications
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to shape feature concepts and interaction patterns
  • Apply and extend existing design systems and component libraries
  • Conduct lightweight user research or usability testing when needed
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and technical constraints
  • Ensure designs align with accessibility and usability best practices
  • Prepare assets and specs for smooth handoff to engineering

Requirements

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design, with significant experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work on data-intensive systems (dashboards, tables, grids, reporting tools, multi-step workflows)
  • Experience designing for multi-role environments with interconnected user workflows
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and engineering to navigate technical constraints and trade-offs
  • Proficiency with design tools
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-driven product development
  • Ability to work independently within a limited-hours engagement
  • Clear communicator who can explain design decisions to technical and non-technical partners

Desired Expereince

  • Bachelors degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience in energy, finance, accounting, or other regulated/operational industries

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, results-driven Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist with strong experience recruiting for the US market within LATAM nearshore models.

We are seeking a talent advisor who understands technology trends, competitive compensation landscapes, and how to build high-impact pipelines in complex, fast-moving environments.

Job Title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist

Location: Brasil (Remote Position)

Start Date: ASAP

Length: Permanent (Full-Time)

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Spanish verbal and written communication skills

Description:

Recruit solid information technology and engineering professionals in different countries, such as Brazil, Colombia, United States, Mexico, Canada, etc.

  • Execute sourcing and engagement strategies designed to identify qualified active and passive candidates through various sourcing channels.
  • Develop and maintain a network of contacts to identify qualified, diverse, and talented candidates; maintain current market knowledge and external trends.
  • Build and maintain meaningful and trusted relationships that result in dynamic hiring candidate experiences.
  • Work on the job description and job posting for each assigned open requirement to be able to post on social media and job boards.
  • Execute the full life cycle recruiting process, including sourcing, interviewing, presenting candidates, and negotiating offers.
  • Execute recruitment plan by aggressively recruiting for well-qualified candidates from a variety of sources, managing selection process to include interviewing, assessing candidates, screening, research, cold calling, and filling the staffing needs within the defined service and performance criteria.
  • Maintain the data integrity within the Applicant Tracking System.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and sourcing across multiple types of roles and functions.
  • Experience recruiting for US-based clients within nearshore LATAM delivery models.
  • Previous IT Recruiting experience is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and maximize team performance, while maintaining a working environment that’s fun and professionally rewarding.
  • Experience with use of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Microsoft Office (e.g, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), career portals and AI Tools.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to optimize sourcing, screening, and candidate engagement.
  • Demonstrate responsibility by independently managing tasks, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high-quality work standards in a remote environment.
  • High level of emotional intelligence and candidate experience focus.
  • Ability to balance and manage many simultaneous competing priorities with multiple profiles.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions with limited information.
  • High level of resilience and ability to stay focused and solution-oriented in challenging hiring processes.

title: Especialista em Chatbot
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ

Remoto | PJ | R$6.000/mês

Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Chatbot com forte visão de experiência do cliente, conversão e otimização de jornada para evoluir nosso principal canal conversacional: WhatsApp + Chatbot .

Procuramos alguém que vá além da automação técnica e consiga transformar fricções reais da operação, dúvidas recorrentes e gargalos de atendimento em melhorias estruturadas e escaláveis no produto conversacional.

Se você vem de atendimento, Customer Success, operações, growth, CRM ou marketing orientado à conversão, essa vaga pode ter alto fit com seu perfil.

Responsabilidades principais:

  • Mapear, estruturar e evoluir fluxos conversacionais do chatbot
  • Identificar gargalos, fricções e pontos de abandono na jornada
  • Propor melhorias estratégicas em:
  • Copy e mensagens
  • Sequência lógica dos fluxos
  • Microconversões
  • CTAs
  • Criar, organizar e priorizar o backlog de melhorias do chatbot
  • Trabalhar em parceria com time técnico para implementação
  • Categorizar dúvidas recorrentes e organizar intents
  • Estruturar documentação oficial dos fluxos
  • Apoiar e executar testes A/B de mensagens e estruturas
  • Conectar aprendizados da operação com evolução do produto

Métricas sob responsabilidade

  • Conversão por etapa
  • Taxa de abandono por fluxo
  • Volume de interações
  • Taxa de resolução automática
  • Tempo médio de jornada
  • Ativação dentro do chatbot

Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência prática com chatbot ou fluxos conversacionais
  • Experiência com CRM, automação ou canais digitais
  • Experiência com mapeamento de jornada do cliente
  • Experiência com análise de métricas (SQL ou BI é diferencial)
  • Vivência com priorização e gestão de backlog
  • Experiência com testes A/B

Diferenciais (muito valorizados)

  • Experiência com WhatsApp API
  • Experiência em fintech, crédito ou serviços financeiros
  • Vivência com ferramentas como:
  • Manychat
  • Zenvia
  • Take Blip
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • RD Station
  • Experiência com categorização e estruturação de intents

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack .Net + React
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.

Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP

Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed

Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)

If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking

Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.

In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.

Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.

Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.

What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.

How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:

Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Empregos.com.br is one of Brazil's premier job and career platforms, connecting professionals with employment opportunities and providing career guidance and training. With over 180,000 job offers from 80,000 companies and a database of more than 1 million resumes, the platform serves as a key resource for job seekers and employers. The service is free for companies to post job openings or search for candidates, aiding in creating meaningful connections in the job market. Empregos.com.br is committed to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity in Brazil.

Role Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Frontend Developer to work directly on building and evolving our digital products.

What you will do on a daily basis:

Develop and enhance frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js

Work with SSR (Server-Side Rendering), technical SEO, and web performance

Consume and integrate REST APIs

Continuously improve Core Web Vitals and search engine indexation

Participate in technical decisions and frontend architecture evolution

Work in agile cycles, with frequent deliveries and constant feedback

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-impact solutions

What we expect from you:

Solid experience with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js

SEO is not a plus — it’s mandatory (rendering, indexing, performance)

Experience consuming Web APIs

Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Experience with Docker containers

Strong knowledge of Git

Ability to translate design into pixel-perfect, high-performance interfaces

Agile mindset: prioritization, short delivery cycles, and continuous improvement

Nice to have:

Experience working on high-traffic projects

Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization

Previous experience with SEO-driven products

What we offer:

100% remote work

Technical autonomy and space for decision-making

A product with real impact and scale

A collaborative environment where we learn and grow together

Contractor agreement (PJ)

If you enjoy solving real problems, working at scale, optimizing SEO and performance, and growing alongside a living product, this opportunity is for you!

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: ServiceNow APM Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a ServiceNow Developer with experience in APM to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. T

Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .

MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only .

The ServiceNow developer will be part of an established team supporting with the implementation of the ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) module. The developer will be activating and configuring the module as well as working closely alongside functional resources to define the system scope and objectives.

Responsibilities :

  • Formulates and defines system scope and objectives.
  • Responsible for program design, coding, testing, debugging and documentation.
  • Technical knowledge and responsibility of all phases of applications systems analysis and programming.
  • Understands the business or function for which application is designed.
  • Continually learn about new technologies, generate new ideas and improve the use of modern technologies across our application portfolio.
  • Configuring and activating Application Portfolio Management (APM)
  • Developing Configuration Item relationships for Business Capabilities, Information Objects, Business Applications, and Application Services
  • Integrating APM with other ServiceNow modules including ITSM and SAM
  • Utilize strong technical competencies and expertise to identify, analyze and troubleshoot any production issues and maintain procedures that meet business user expectations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams & development teams to understand and provide automated solutions/fixes.
  • Contribute to the continual improvement of Delivery and Support Services processes as well as the maturing of the different portfolios, capabilities, expertise, and best practices in consideration of the user and stakeholder needs and requirements.
  • Participate in SCRUM events and complete assigned items within the determined Sprint target.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow administration experience in the following areas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
  • Experience working in ServiceNow platform as an Admin & Developer
  • Experience in development of Service Catalogs, implementing ACLs, transform maps, Flows via flow designer, client scripts, CMDB health metrics
  • Configuring Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps, Information Objects
  • Knowledge of development languages: XML, HTML, CSS, Java, and Java Script
  • Prior working experience on APM module is desirable
  • Ability to work in global distributed setting without supervision

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.

This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.

Why Join Us

· Remote teaching structure

· Self-managed scheduling

· Access to professional development opportunities

· Supportive global educator network

· Dedicated online teaching portal

Core Requirements

· Bachelor’s Degree or higher

· Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

· Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

· Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence

Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

· Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

· Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

· Experience with international learners

Language Capability Requirements

· English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

· Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred

﻿ Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.

Students may include:

• School-aged learners

• University students

• Working professionals

• Adult learners seeking conversational fluency

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.

Next Step
  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

· Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.

Students may include:

• School-aged learners

• University students

• Working professionals

• Adult learners seeking conversational fluency

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.

title: Pessoa Team Lead
description:
Principais atribuições e entregas contínuas do cargo:

● Conduzir rituais (planning, review, retro), realizar 1:1s, dar feedbacks e gerir desempenho.

● Contratar, onboarding e desenvolver o time (PDI, mentoring, trilhas).

● Co-planejar roadmap com PM e desdobrar em OKRs/KPIs e metas claras.

● Garantir previsibilidade: gestão de escopo, riscos, dependências e comunicação com stakeholders.

● Liderança técnica do squad: padrões, revisão de código, desenho de soluções, RFCs leves; escalar arquitetura ampla quando necessário.

● Elevar práticas: testes automatizados, CI/CD, observabilidade e segurança/LGPD.

● Gestão de incidentes: on-call, runbooks, RCA e follow-ups.

● Acompanhar e melhorar DORA (lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, MTTR) e SLO/SLI.

● FinOps básico: visibilidade e otimização de custos de nuvem.

● Promover cultura AI-First (automação, opilots) com responsabilidade.

Competências Técnicas:

● Stack: .NET Core, C#, Angular, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

● Boas práticas: arquitetura modular, testes, CI/CD, observabilidade (logs/métricas/traces), segurança (LGPD, OWASP, gestão de segredos).

● Métricas e operação: OKRs/KPIs, DORA, SLO/SLI, incident response.

● Diferenciais: pagamentos/antifraude, experimentação (feature flags/A-B), Team Topologies, SRE. ● Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso BRT (±2).

● Participação em on-call quando necessário.

● Inglês técnico para leitura/colaboração.

Competências Comportamentais:

● Tomada de decisão com trade-offs explícitos.

● Mentalidade data-informed e orientação a clientes.

● Habilidade de coaching/mentoria e desenvolvimento de carreira do time.

● Ownership, senso de urgência e foco em resultados.

Experiências Desejadas:

● Tipos de vivências profissionais que aceleram a curva de aprendizado e performance.

● Atuação relevante em engenharia de software (backend/fullstack), participando de decisões arquiteturais e entregas de alta complexidade técnica.

● Experiência na condução de times multidisciplinares, sendo responsável por metas, performance e evolução do time.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Na Ambra, buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer que transforme complexidade em confiabilidade. Você vai atuar na construção e evolução de infraestruturas escaláveis, automatizadas e seguras, sendo peça-chave para a estabilidade e performance dos nossos produtos. Se você gosta de resolver problemas, automatizar processos e garantir que tudo funcione de forma fluida nos bastidores, essa vaga é pra você.

Objetivo

Planejar, implementar e administrar soluções de infraestrutura em cloud, observando aspectos de segurança, performance, governança e custo.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, implementar e administrar clusters Kubernetes no Azure (AKS).
  • Atuar com Docker no suporte ao desenvolvimento, pipelines e criação de imagens base.
  • Planejar e implementar projetos de CI/CD em conjunto com os desenvolvedores, utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Implementar ferramentas de monitoramento de serviços e infraestrutura.
  • Acompanhar logs, traces e observabilidade por meio do Datadog.
  • Participar de processos de suporte ao time de desenvolvimento e de implantações, quando necessário.
  • Gerenciar ambientes Linux.
  • Contribuir com novas ideias, propostas e melhorias nos processos de DevOps, CI/CD e na estrutura dos ambientes.

Conhecimentos obrigatórios

  • AKS (Azure)
  • Helm
  • Pipelines e Releases no Azure DevOps
  • Administração de sistemas Linux
  • Docker
  • Git

Diferenciais

  • Terraform
  • ECS / Fargate (AWS)
  • Postman, Insomnia ou Swagger (testes de APIs REST)
  • Configuração de Apache
  • AWS CLI
  • Azure CLI
  • Shell Script
  • Noções de PHP / Laravel
  • Noções de Python / FastAPI
  • Capacidade de entendimento da arquitetura de microserviços, APIs e componentes de infraestrutura

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding

UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.

Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.

You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

Main Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach

  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.

3. Strategy & CRM Excellence

  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.

Linguistic Versatility:

  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).
  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.

Tech Stack

  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!

Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.
  • Experiência e Flexibilidade : Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.
  • Habilidades Tecnológicas : Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.
  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.

Competências

  • Capacidade de conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.
  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.

Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.

Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.

Ambiente de Trabalho : Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Especialista Regulatório
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar em demandas que envolvam temas regulatórios do setor de saneamento básico, incluindo a análise e elaboração de resposta para notificações, ofícios, pareceres e demais documentos jurídicos relacionados à execução contratual.
  • Apoiar as demais áreas internas em suas demandas, auxiliando nas respostas das correspondências e na análise de riscos jurídicos e regulatórios envolvidos.
  • Apoiar na estruturação e condução de pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro do Contrato.
  • Atuar em demandas estratégicas relacionadas a fiscalizações e penalidades no âmbito do Contrato.
  • Realizar o acompanhamento próximo e a gestão ativa de processos considerados estratégicos para a companhia, bem como de Autos de Infração Ambiental, com o apoio de escritórios externos.
  • Gerir escritórios externos, monitorando prazos, estratégias processuais e qualidade técnica das entregas.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Grau de Instrução Mínimo: Ensino Superior Completo (Direito)
  • Grau de Instrução Desejado: Pós-Graduação
  • Requisito Legal: Inscrição ativa na OAB


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia ou conhecimento específico em regulação do setor de saneamento básico.
  • Experiência prévia ou conhecimento específico em setores regulados de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência prévia ou conhecimento específico em direito ambiental.



Informações adicionais


  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

title: Vendedor bilingue (Ingles)
description:
Descrição da Empresa Bright N’ Shine Pet Dental é uma empresa inovadora no setor de cuidados para animais de estimação, oferecendo um serviço especializado de limpeza dental cosmética móvel e não anestésica para gatos e cães nos Estados Unidos. Nosso modelo de negócio é sólido e estrategicamente projetado, com uma presença crescente no mercado de cuidados pet nos Estados Unidos. Valorizamos o trabalho de uma equipe altamente qualificada e buscamos constantemente excelência em nossos serviços. Junte-se a nós para fazer parte de um mercado sempre em expansão e fazer a diferença na saúde dos animais de estimação.

Descrição do Cargo Buscamos um vendedor bilingue (inglês) para atuar em nosso time. O profissional será responsável por identificar e prospectar novos clientes, atender e orientar clientes em potencial sobre os serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e estabelecer relações comerciais de longo prazo. Será necessário usar habilidades de comunicação em inglês e português de forma eficaz no atendimento ao cliente, garantindo uma experiência de alta qualidade. Este é um cargo remoto baseado em contrato.

  • Idiomas: Fluência em inglês e português é essencial para comunicação com diversos tipos de clientes.

title: Técnico de Suporte II
description:

Responsável pela manutenção e monitoramento dos ativos de redes, bem como seus serviços, visando a disponibilidade dos recursos (hardware e software) necessários para todo o Grupo Pereira.

• Conhecimento básico nas ferramentas de monitoramento ZABBIX ou Nagios;

• TCP/IP IPv4 (Noções Básicas);

• Hardware de Servidor (Básico);

• Sistemas Operacionais proprietários e livres (noções básicas);

• Redes wireless (básico);

• Cabeamento Estruturado;

• Configuração de Equipamentos de Interconexão.

O nosso propósito é ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, pensando nisso oferecemos:

• Plano de Saúde;

• Plano Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Refeição no Local;

• Vale transporte;

• Suporte Social;

• Descontos especiais para compras em nossas redes.

title: Customer Service Representative (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.

Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

Responsibilities

  • Handle customer inquiries via live chat, email, and other channels regarding accounts, trading, payments, etc.
  • Assist customers with KYC verification, account security setup, and dispute resolution.
  • Accurately document and escalate customer issues, collaborating with technical teams for complex cases.
  • Stay updated on futures trading rules and promptly communicate platform announcements/risk alerts (training provided).
  • Adapt to shift schedules (if required) to ensure coverage during target market hours.
  • Willing to work weekends and irregular hours which will include night shifts.

Requirements

  • Have an online customer support experience, and proficiency in tools like Zendesk/LiveChat.
  • Fast learner, able to master derivatives trading terminology quickly.
  • Patient, resilient, and skilled in de-escalating high-tension situations.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian/Portuguese user communication styles; finance or customer service experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential.
